as_told.title: 2010 F.E. Warren missile shutdown attributed to cigar-shaped object

plain: Michels says that in 2010 the nuclear missiles at F.E. Warren Air Force Base in Wyoming went offline for about an hour, 59 minutes by one account, and that staff on site linked the outage to an object flying in the local airspace, a Tic Tac, meaning a white oval shaped like the mint, though in one telling he calls it cigar-shaped. He credits the researcher Robert Hastings, author of the book UFOs and Nukes, who he says heard it through retired and serving missile technicians, as well as a Wired magazine article and a man named John Mills, and he adds that President Barack Obama was briefed. He pairs it with a 1967 case at Malmstrom in Montana as signs that unknown objects take an interest in nuclear weapons.
